notes: The first soil signal on the register. Soils are one of SoNaRR's three cross-cutting natural resources but are foregrounded by no strategic indicator, which is why the scan missed this until the soil_land cluster was added on 24 July 2026. Supports SI2 and SI4 if the recommendations are taken up, since soil condition drives both habitat restoration and diffuse pollution. Confidence is medium rather than high for one reason: no Welsh Government response to the recommendations could be found, and the usual response window has long passed. That missing response is the live hook, so this is a follow-up rather than a watch item.
summary: The Senedd's Economy, Trade and Rural Affairs Committee published 'Digging the dirt: Improving Wales' soil health' on 18 November 2025, after evidence sessions in May and June 2025. Its recommendations include putting the GAEC 4 and 5 soil standards on a statutory footing, introducing a voluntary minimum standard for soil health that could later become statutory, and sharing soil data with farmers. The Agricultural Soil Policy Statement (28 April 2025) is the current policy baseline.
title: Senedd committee report 'Digging the dirt' calls for statutory soil health standards; no government response published
